title: leucanthemopsis alpina subsp. pseudotomentosa
intro: Leucanthemopsis alpina subsp. pseudotomentosa, commonly known as Alpine Daisy, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemopsis alpina subsp. pseudotomentosa include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
